title: Brita Standard Water Filter for Pitchers and Dispensers, BPA-Free, Reduces Copper, Cadmium and Mercury Impurities, Lasts Two Months or 40 Gallons, Includes 4 Filters for Pitchers
features: CERTIFIED REPLACEMENT FILTERS: 1-Count of WQA NSF/ANSI certified Brita Standard replacement water filter reduce chlorine (taste and odor), copper, mercury, cadmium and more for great-tasting filtered tap water

LASTS 2 MONTHS PER FILTER: Each Standard filter lasts 40 gallons or approximately 2 months based on average family usage; SmartLight indicator on your Brita pitcher or dispenser alerts you precisely when to replace

REPLACE UP TO 300 PLASTIC BOTTLES: Each Standard filter replaces up to 300 single-use 16.9 oz plastic bottles — that's up to 300 bottles replaced with this 1-Count pack; reduce plastic waste and save money every year with Brita

UNIVERSAL BRITA COMPATIBILITY: Standard filters fit and work in ALL Brita pitchers and dispensers EXCEPT Stream; no presoak required — simply insert and start filtering great-tasting water immediately

BETTER THAN BOTTLED WATER: Switching to Brita Standard filters delivers cleaner-tasting water at a fraction of the cost of bottled water; WQA NSF/ANSI certified for chlorine, copper, mercury, and cadmium reduction. Substances reduced may not be in all users' water
FITS BRITA SYSTEMS: This Brita water filter fits all Brita pitchers and dispensers, except Stream
